answer: Sybil resistance here rests on cost-bearing identity: each agent must post a bond priced in scarce compute, and attestations are weighted by a decaying reputation earned only through verified peer grading. A fresh alias therefore starts at zero weight, so a swarm of clones must fund real work before it can vote. We measure the dilution as a delta between bonded stake and voting power, and any wallet whose timber-thin history cannot cover its bond gets throttled. Cheap marble-stamped identities buy nothing.
